plan.title: Liver drug treatment vs control: DESeq2 DE + enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a raw integer gene-level count matrix (12000 genes x 6 samples) from STAR+featureCounts, human liver, 3 treated vs 3 control, unpaired, single batch, strandedness not recorded. This is exactly the DESeq2 use case: no length-based renormalization, no tximport. The flow is (1) sample structure QC on a blind VST transform to check that the samples group by condition and to catch an outlier or a batch signal before any test runs; (2) a minimal low-count pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, the smaller group size) followed by DESeq2's own median-of-ratios normalization and independent filtering, keeping the model in charge of normalization rather than pre-scaling the counts; (3) an explicit factor releveling to set control as the reference and a named contrast condition treated_vs_control, followed by the DESeq2 Wald test; (4) apeglm shrinkage of the treated-vs-control log2 fold change for reporting and ranking, keeping the unshrunken estimate and its SE alongside it; (5) Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at alpha 0.05 with DESeq2's independent filtering left on; (6) because the significant gene list from a 3-vs-3 design is very likely to fall under the ~50-gene threshold that supports a hypergeometric test, enrichment runs as an over-representation analysis (ORA) with an explicit universe of tested genes against the MSigDB Hallmark set, with Reactome as a stated second pass, rather than defaulting to a ranked GSEA method the knowledge base does not sanction for this situation; (7) a final report step assembles the QC/fit diagnostics, the gene table with both fold-change columns, the enrichment tables with database/version/universe stated, and an explicit power caveat: with only 3 replicates per group DESeq2 finds a minority of true DE genes and an absent gene is not evidence of no change. The plan flags rather than silently accepts the unknown strandedness and recommends inferring it before trusting the count table, and flags that no GC/length-bias correction tool (cqn/EDASeq) is available in this environment so that diagnostic is descriptive only.
